text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Glory and fulfillment to all Umamusume—in 
the Grand Masters, the embodiment of the 
Three Goddesses' wish, <chrname> achieved a 
brilliant victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aided by the knowledge of the Umamusume 
who ran before her, <chrname> stood triumphant at 
the pinnacle of the modern generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses praised their 
achievements and smiled with satisfaction.
